{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers, excluding QA orders
loyal_completed = df[
    (df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (df['status'] == 'completed') &
    (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders from LOYAL customers: {mean_revenue}')"}
